profile.name: Addyson Campbell
profile.headline: Engineering safer, smarter processes.
profile.intro: I’m a Chemical Engineering student with hands-on experience across power generation, plant engineering, process optimization, and R&D. I use data, experiments, and engineering fundamentals to solve practical operating problems.
profile.about: My experience spans condenser performance in coal power generation, pilot-scale product development, papermaking process optimization, and construction materials testing. I’m especially interested in R&D, process, production, and plant engineering roles where disciplined analysis can improve safety, reliability, and performance.

items.title: Condenser Performance & Reliability
items.summary: Evaluating condenser cleanliness, thermal efficiency losses, and suspected heat exchanger leakage across three coal power generating units.
items.context: Plant Engineer Intern · Lower Colorado River Authority
items.challenge: Condenser condition directly affects generating-unit efficiency and reliability. The work required distinguishing performance losses and possible leakage mechanisms using a full year of plant operating and chemistry data.
approach: Built custom Excel models to perform HEI condenser performance evaluations for three coal power generating units.
Analyzed 12 months of operating and chemistry data using AVEVA PI Vision, SharePoint, Hanara, and P&IDs.
Investigated conductivity, chloride, copper, dissolved oxygen, hydrogen, scaling, fouling, and corrosion trends related to suspected heat exchanger leakage.
items.outcome: Authored engineering reports and presented data-backed recommendations intended to improve condenser performance and plant reliability.

items.title: Pilot-Scale Product Development
items.summary: Developed and optimized oral nicotine formulations through experimental design, product testing, process evaluation, and competitive benchmarking.
items.context: R&D / Process Design Engineer Intern · Altria
items.challenge: Pilot-scale formulation development required balancing product performance, manufacturability, experimental rigor, and regulatory expectations.
approach: Designed DOE studies and used statistical analysis to optimize pilot-scale formulations.
Reverse engineered competitor products to benchmark formulations and identify product innovation opportunities.
Developed Excel macros to automate engineering calculations and improve analysis efficiency.
items.outcome: Advanced formulation and process-development work in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams while maintaining FDA and OSHA compliance.

items.title: Papermaking Process Optimization
items.summary: Applied data analysis, process troubleshooting, and automation to support quality, uptime, and reliability in papermaking operations.
items.context: Process Engineer Co-op · Packaging Corporation of America
items.challenge: Papermaking operations required timely troubleshooting and clear use of process data to address downtime and product-quality issues.
approach: Analyzed operating data to identify process trends and support troubleshooting.
Created Excel macros to make recurring analysis faster and more consistent.
Worked with operations, maintenance, and safety teams to develop practical reliability improvements.
items.outcome: Supported data-driven process changes focused on reducing downtime, improving product quality, and strengthening operating reliability.

items.title: Construction Materials Testing
items.summary: Performed standards-based asphalt and concrete testing and translated field observations into clear technical documentation.
items.context: Lab & Safety Engineer Assistant · Texas Department of Transportation
items.challenge: Roadway materials and construction work needed consistent verification against engineering plans and recognized testing standards.
approach: Performed asphalt and concrete testing in accordance with ASTM standards.
Inspected roadway construction activities and reviewed engineering plans.
Recorded test results, field conditions, and technical findings for engineering review.
items.outcome: Helped provide reliable materials data and field documentation to support roadway construction quality and safety.
